name: e-commerce_playwright
description: Playwright end-to-end tests for Automation Exercise registration and login flows.

scripts.ci:pr: npm run typecheck && npm run test:api && npm run test:ui:chromium
scripts.ci:full: npm run typecheck && npm run test:api && npm run test:ui
scripts.ci:allure: bash -lc 'set +e; npm run typecheck; TYPECHECK_EXIT=$?; npm run test:api; API_EXIT=$?; npm run test:ui; UI_EXIT=$?; npm run allure:generate; ALLURE_EXIT=$?; echo "Typecheck exit code: $TYPECHECK_EXIT"; echo "API tests exit code: $API_EXIT"; echo "UI tests exit code: $UI_EXIT"; echo "Allure generation exit code: $ALLURE_EXIT"; if [ $TYPECHECK_EXIT -ne 0 ] || [ $API_EXIT -ne 0 ] || [ $UI_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi; exit 0'
scripts.allure:clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); for (const path of ['reports/allure-results', 'reports/allure-report']) fs.rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.allure:generate: mkdir -p reports/allure-results reports/allure-report && allure generate reports/allure-results --clean -o reports/allure-report
